Identified as this saint because: Found by route 4, a hand alias: Category:20,000 Martyrs of Nicomedia, which no title built from the folder's own names reaches. 1949x1328. The folder IS the company, not an individual, so a group image is the right kind of picture here and the file names the company and the date it illustrates. It is a Menologion of Basil II miniature of the burning of the church, so it is a SCENE and in landscape; the 28 December feast is the one this folder keeps in all four calendars. Commons describes it: Мученики 20000, в Никомидии в церкви сожженные the 20,000 martyrs of Nicomedia, including: Glycerius, Zeno, Theophilus, Dorotheus, Mardonius, Migdonius, Indes, Gorgonius, Peter, Euthymius, and the virgins Agape, Domna, and Theophila Константинополь. 985 г. Миниатюра Минология Василия II.  Ватиканская библиотека. Рим.
